name: Dunavecse (Hungary)
description: Yellow field with a green chevron at the hoist and a central horizontal stripe of blue and white, charged at the centre with the town arms of Dunavecse (a blue shield with a yellow cup, with a helm and green mantling).
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Dunavecse arms with helm and mantling
